ideas.pitch: A highly agile, low-center-of-gravity 30x30cm remote-controlled robot optimized for maximum speed and sharp turns on obstacle tracks.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Race: Build an autonomous or remote-controlled robot under 30x30x30cm to complete timed runs on an obstacle track without penalties.
ideas.title: SpeedDemon RC Chassis Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly focuses on the core judging criteria of completion time and obstacle clearance by prioritizing lightweight mechanical design and rapid maneuverability.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous dual-mode robot using ultrasonic sensors and IR arrays to navigate complex obstacle courses under the 3-minute time limit.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Race: Build an autonomous or remote-controlled robot under 30x30x30cm to complete timed runs on an obstacle track without penalties.
ideas.title: AutoNav Line and Wall-Avoidance Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on the autonomous run option, which often secures higher technical appreciation from judges compared to manual remote-controlled units.

ideas.pitch: A compact 30cm-spec robot equipped with a low-latency ESP32-CAM module to let the driver navigate blind spots on the track via live video feedback.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Race: Build an autonomous or remote-controlled robot under 30x30x30cm to complete timed runs on an obstacle track without penalties.
ideas.title: TeleOps First-Person View (FPV) Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical robotics with an engaging live-action demo, ensuring a high-impact presentation that stands out during timed runs.

ideas.pitch: A robust, low-power autonomous racer featuring servo-mounted distance scanners to dynamically map and weave through dynamic track obstacles.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Race: Build an autonomous or remote-controlled robot under 30x30x30cm to complete timed runs on an obstacle track without penalties.
ideas.title: Obstacle-Dodger Arduino Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly optimizes for the 'number of obstacles cleared' judging metric by implementing automated clearance algorithms rather than manual guesswork.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent racing robot featuring onboard wheel encoders and automated speed modulation to minimize penalty points from hitting track boundaries.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Race: Build an autonomous or remote-controlled robot under 30x30x30cm to complete timed runs on an obstacle track without penalties.
ideas.title: Precision Braking and Lap Timer Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Minimizes penalty points for rule violations, which is a decisive factor when competing times among top qualifiers are extremely close.
